module: LH-1 MVP build variant (stage 0 of the starter S): cad/lh1/machine_family/mvp.py via build.py MVP
status: CAD and calculation only; nothing built or measured; designed and checked in the model; figures CALCULATED or ASSUMED as labelled
what_it_is:
the starter's own frame, base, gantry, beam, deck strips, drawer, enclosure and control compartment at size S, generated by
the same scene functions with the full S layout (so every one of those parts is the starter's part, unchanged), plus ONE tool carriage
(carriage A: Z axis, plunger pusher, force and contact switches) holding ONE eight-channel 30-300 uL tool (M300) on the full design's
tool plate and vee seats, held by a manual fork clamp MCL-1 in the latch channel in place of the LTG-1 latch.  The deck has passive
places only.  Nothing of the dock, the latch, carriage B, the gripper, the modules, the cameras, tip parking, towers or extraction.
variant_basis: frame, deck strips, drawer, enclosure and services generated by scene.py from the FULL S layout (so they are the starter's parts unchanged); stations from MVP_LAYOUT; head = FamilyHead reduced to carriage A with the MCL-1 clamp

mvp_only: MCL-K_clamp_fork (MVP clamp, replaces the LTG-1 latch until stage 5)

envelope_mm.note: frame, panels, floor, feet, drawer: the starter's own (no extraction fan fitted: the starter's 1,456 mm width with the fan becomes 1,344 mm)

Y.note: the starter's travel, unchanged (frame, gantry, rails, belts, end stops); the MVP uses part of it: the dock row behind row G is not used

rules.R1: behind (+Y) a place worked deep: height <= 51 mm; behind shallow/centre work <= 72 mm (rev K stack cap from the head's rear parts)
rules.R2: beside (X) a place worked deep by an eight-channel tool: height <= 64 mm (K19); TC-1's own lid strip excepted (CAD-checked)
rules.R3: tip frames (p10, p200, p300) in the back row G only (bare-nozzle single-tip pick-up needs nothing behind)
rules.N1: beside a tip frame: height <= 57 mm (the eight-channel cradle cheeks pass over the next place in X)
rules.N2: in front (-Y) of a place worked deep by single channels: height <= 100 mm (the cradle straps reach about 25 mm in front)
rules.N3: tip waste in column 1 only, with column 0 of that row empty (VC-2 camera and bracket stand 34-38 mm outside the place on -X up to z 102)
rules.N4: TC-1 at column 1 with its lid park directly behind; column 2 of both its rows without under-deck parts (body 165 mm wide); column 0 of both rows unusable (the 140 mm lid guide strip stands there)
rules.N5: shaker at the right edge (column 4), set 8 mm outward with the shelf cut to x 350; its column-3 neighbour without under-deck parts
rules.N6: column 0 is pipette-only: nothing there that needs the gripper
rules.N7: tip waste in rows F, A or B (over the crate in the drawer; those rows never move)
rules.N8: the cold tube blocks CTB-1 and CTB-2 side by side in one row (one module zone, one connector)
rules.N9: hazardous liquid not beside or in front of/behind a buffer reservoir (deck_k Y8: splash and carry-over)
rules.N10: TC-1 in row F or A only (a row inserted in front of row G never separates it from its lid park)
rules.N11: the narrow tip parking TPK-S only at column 0 of the tip-waste row (the half of the place VC-2 leaves free; its comb ends 10.7 mm from the VC-2 bracket, CAD-checked); it is the one station N3 admits there

static_all_pairs.method: every placed item against every other with a different owner (place, slot, bay or part): stations, modules, racks and labware against each other and against frame, deck, shelf, dock, drawer, panels and services; bounding-box prefilter, OCC boolean common > 1 mm3; designed contacts excluded: YCH-F_y_chain_envelope / YCB-F_y_chain_end_bracket (chain moving end); XCH-F_x_chain_envelope / x_chain_end_bracket (chain moving end); MGN15H_Y_block / MGN15_Y_rail (blocks on the rail)

head_internal (MCL-1).method: MCL-1 plate and screw against every other MVP head part at s 0, 120, full stroke and eject over-travel, OCC boolean > 1 mm3

interference.method: machine_l engine with the MVP head: transit over every place with tips on and off, the four travel corners; the M300 on carriage A lowered at every working place at 50/85/100 % of its stroke (tip pick-up at G3, into the reservoir F2 and both plates to the floor, tip check and nozzle check at the gate and eject height at B1); eject over-travel at B1; all-pairs static check; gantry at front/middle/back against the static scene; head against gantry

coupling_clamp_MCL-1.design: MCL-1: an 11 mm steel fork (C45 class, ASSUMED) lying in the coupling bracket's existing latch channel, its two prongs under the stud head, feet (heel) under the prong tips on the channel floor, and an M5 dog-point set screw through its tongue bearing on the channel floor; tightening the screw levers the plate up about the heel and pulls the stud (retention knob) straight up, seating the three tooling balls in the three vee seats.  The stud's cone bears on the two slot flanks, symmetric about the stud axis: the pull is axial (no one-sided wedge, unlike the LTG-1 jaw: verification W2 does not arise)

tightening.tool: torque screwdriver 0.3-5 N m (already on the tool list), 2.5 mm hex bit, from above

coupling_clamp_MCL-1.hertz_note: ball on flat, largest preload + 150 N; same basis as head_l (limit about 4 GPa)
coupling_clamp_MCL-1.side_load: nominally zero: the two flank contacts are symmetric about the stud axis and the screw and heel react on the bracket, not the tool; the plate moves in Y only with the screw loose.  Residual side load from flank friction and plate tolerance UNVERIFIED: commissioning check C5 re-clamps 20 times and reads the nozzle position with a dial indicator
coupling_clamp_MCL-1.tool_change: MANUAL at this stage: support the tool, loosen the set screw two turns, pull the fork's front tab forward 28.5 mm until its wide part stops at the bracket's front slot (the prongs are then clear of the stud head), lower the tool out; reverse to fit; re-torque; run the tip-gate nozzle check.  The machine never changes a tool by itself in the MVP

mechanism_audit.rule: available / needed >= 1.5 at the firmware's current; travel needed <= hard limit (machine_family/mechanisms.py method)

rows.mechanism: tip pick-up, eight p300 tips, force-ended (cradle force switch)
rows.drive: Z at the force current 1.3 A

travel.what: deepest pick-up stroke inside the Z travel

rows.mechanism: tip eject by over-travel against the fixed finger
plunger push, M300 (50 N) at <= 5 mm/s

travel.what: M300 plunger stroke + 3 mm contact window

rows.note: lower of the sourcing curve (128 N) and system.yaml's model (128.3 N at 0.7 A); the MVP carries no SYR, so the 5 mm/s cap the full design takes from SYR could be relaxed for M300 after CT-0d (not done here)

rows.mechanism: plunger contact (pusher pad on the slider, contact switch about 2 N, ASSUMED)
pusher homing into its RETRACTED switch

travel.what: switch trips 0.5 mm before the internal stop

rows.mechanism: coupling held by the manual clamp MCL-1 against: tip pick-up, eight tips, 150 N design load half on an end tip 31.5 mm off
rows.drive: MCL-1 set screw at 0.30 N m (lower end of the preload band)

rows.mechanism: coupling held by the manual clamp MCL-1 against: tip eject 90 N at the eject pad 30 mm off axis (+ weight and accelerations 19 N / 0.31 N m)
rows.drive: MCL-1 set screw at 0.30 N m (lower end of the preload band)

rows.mechanism: coupling held by the manual clamp MCL-1 against: plunger 50 N on axis (M300), pusher reaction (+19 N / 0.31 N m)
rows.drive: MCL-1 set screw at 0.30 N m (lower end of the preload band)

rows.mechanism: MCL-1 fork prongs in bending at the largest screw force

mechanism_audit.not_in_the_MVP: latch release and re-latch, dock lift, comb strip and re-pick, X/Y comb slide, gripper, lid lift, TC-1 lid, SYR return spring

guarding.fitted: the starter's full enclosure: door (PC) with the coded non-contact door sensor (ISO 14119 type 4) into SR2/KM3/KM4, side, back, roof and floor sheets, hand-off blank plates; e-stop (40 mm mushroom) and reset on the left side panel into SR1/KM1/KM2 (system.yaml ESTOP, DOOR)
guarding.why: the full design removes motion power by the e-stop AND by opening the door (system.yaml power MOTION switched_by [ESTOP, DOOR]); the MVP has the same moving axes (22 kg Y gantry class, belts, a 1.3 A Z screw that pushes 120 N+), so an open frame with only an e-stop would be less guarding than the design requires.  The panels are the starter's own parts, so fitting them now costs nothing later
guarding.not_fitted: extraction fan (no ethanol in the MVP; the grille stays and the airflow switch is not used)
